systems.system: biometric passport enrolment and personalisation system
systems.owner: the government (Foreign Affairs); supplied by Dermalog under a US$48 million contract awarded in 2022
systems.tiers: biometric capture centres in provincial capitals: 50 fixed and mobile stations in the country and 50 mobile units at diplomatic missions; online application

systems.owner: Trident (Singapore), under a public-private partnership whose first phase began in April 2025

note: A passport article. Its only mentions of civil status are prospective and undescribed: digitisation is 'meant to' increase the reliability of civil registries, and the passport would 'in the future' give access to online services such as civil status documents; no civil registration system is named.
